verdict.rationale: The evidence shows two first-party AI features: a Gemini AI assistant in Gmail (pricing page) and Google Meet's 'Take notes for me', which generates AI notes. Each is only a one-line mention, so it is unclear whether these produce insights and suggestions from the user's data across the product. Missing for 10: detailed docs on Gemini generating insights or suggestions from user data (Docs, Sheets, Drive, Gmail), coverage beyond Gmail and Meet notes, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
